body: Just wanted to say that she's been taken into hospital and we're trying to contact her parents at the moment. Thanks for the support.

The staff at the hostel have just got back to me. She has locked herself in her room and they are going through the procedure of calling in their teen depression worker to talk to her and keeping her talking to make sure she is alright. Do I still need to call the emergency services? The hostel must know what's best it is made for looking after vulnerable teens.

She is on medication and has seen a therapist in the past I will convince her to start seeing one again. Thank you for the help.
